extracted.intended_audience: patent researchers, historians, librarians, inventors, and USPTO staff seeking an alphabetical index of 1878 patentees and their inventions
extracted.subtask_description: An alphabetical index (annual register) of patentees for the year 1878 listing names, residences, invention titles, patent numbers, dates, and Gazette/volume references. Intended as a lookup/reference list rather than guidance or evaluative criteria.
